info.name: Support Guidance Assistant API (v2)
info.description:
Every endpoint of the Support Guidance Assistant. Set `agent_key` / `admin_key` (the values from AGENT_API_KEYS / ADMIN_API_KEYS, without the `label:` prefix) and `baseUrl` in the environment. Requests that create resources save their ids (`chat_id`, `action_id`, `server_id`, `run_id`, `version`, `cursor`) into collection variables for the next requests.

Suggested order: Companies -> Guidelines/Upload -> Integrations (bind, test, go-live) -> Chats -> Actions -> Evals -> Internal.

Generated by `scripts/export_postman.py`.

item.name: Companies
item.description: Tenants. Create is admin-only; reads need an agent key.

request.description: 201, or 409 COMPANY_EXISTS if it already exists.

item.name: Guidelines
item.description: Versioned uploads, compiled playbooks, review and activation. `{{company}}` selects the tenant; `{{version}}` the version number.

request.description: 202 (background) or 201 when INGESTION_SYNC=true. Parses, compiles, indexes, evaluates; auto-approves and activates by default. 409 DUPLICATE_GUIDELINES if identical to the active version; 422 UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT for non-.txt.

formdata.description: Pick the .txt file (Postman needs a path in its working directory or an absolute path).

exec: try { const v = pm.response.json().version_number; if (v) pm.collectionVariables.set('version', v); } catch (e) { console.log('could not save version', e); }

request.description: Only ready + pending/rejected versions; activates if uploaded with activate=true. 409 if already approved.
Not allowed on the active version (409 VERSION_IS_ACTIVE).
Only ready + approved (409 VERSION_NOT_READY / VERSION_NOT_APPROVED).
204. Refuses the active version (409). Compiled rows cascade.

item.name: Integrations
item.description: Admin: capability registry, company secrets, MCP servers and capability bindings (draft -> test -> go-live).

request.description: Encrypted at rest; the value is never returned.

exec: try { const v = pm.response.json().id; if (v) pm.collectionVariables.set('server_id', v); } catch (e) { console.log('could not save server_id', e); }

request.description: Connects to the server and stores its tool list (502 TOOL_ERROR if unreachable).
Creates/updates the binding as draft. Stores: bookshop_orders | vpn_accounts.

item.name: Bind capability: mock write with policy (refund.create)

request.description: Only a single SELECT is accepted (422 otherwise). Runs in a READ ONLY transaction with a timeout and row limit.
Reads are executed with the sample args; writes are only validated unless execute_write=true. Success moves draft -> tested.
Only from tested (409 BINDING_NOT_TESTED).

request.description: Stored on the chat and added as an agent_feedback eval case.

item.name: Actions
item.description: Proposed writes: the agent approves (executes exactly once) or rejects.

request.description: Re-checks binding + policy, executes with the idempotency key. Approving again returns the stored result; 409 ACTION_NOT_PENDING if denied, rejected or still executing.
Empty expected_intent_keys = an out-of-scope (negative) case.
mode: retrieval (search only) or full (adds the router LLM). version_number null = active version.
